data.name: malformed-json
data.value: The request body is not valid JSON.
data.comment: Title of the 400 problem returned when a body cannot be parsed.

data.name: jsonapi-document-invalid
data.value: The request document is not a valid JSON:API document.
data.comment: Title of the 400 problem returned when a JSON body has the wrong JSON:API shape.

data.name: not-acceptable
data.value: No acceptable response media type was requested.
data.comment: Title of the 406 problem returned when the Accept header excludes both supported types.

data.name: unsupported-media-type
data.value: The request media type is not supported.
data.comment: Title of the 415 problem returned when a body uses a media type other than JSON:API.

data.name: validation
data.comment: Title of the 422 problem returned when one or more attributes fail validation.

data.name: resource-identity-mismatch
data.value: The route and relationship identifiers do not match.
data.comment: Title of the 409 problem returned when two identifiers for one resource differ.

data.name: concurrent-modification
data.value: The resource changed before this request could be applied.
data.comment: Title of the 409 problem returned after a lost update; the client reads and retries.

data.name: rate-limited
data.comment: Title of the 429 problem returned by either rate-limit layer.

data.name: internal
data.comment: Title of the 500 problem returned for any unhandled failure. The body carries no detail.
